name: INV-CEA-XX
desc: The INV-CEA-XX is a fanless industrial gateway designed for high-performance edge computing and robust connectivity, featuring an Intel X7425E processor and extensive cellular/Wi-Fi expansion capabilities. It differentiates itself through quad-Gigabit Ethernet ports, dual isolated serial interfaces (RS232/RS485), and flexible mounting options, making it highly adaptable for harsh environments. Primarily targeted at industrial automation, telecommunications, and smart city infrastructure where reliable long-term operation is critical.
cpu: Intel X7425E/X7433RE/X7835RE/x7809C/i3-N305/N350 Quad Core/Octa Core with 3.9 GHz turbo frequency
ram: Up to 32 GB DDR4 or 64 GB SODIMM DDR5
storage: Up to 512 GB SSD and 64 GB eMMC
housing: Aluminum Heat Sink with CRCA Enclosure
